subject.title: fix(android): preserve chat sends across reconnect recovery

question: Should this Android reconnect-recovery PR wait for live Android reconnect proof and a non-closing link to the broader sequence-cursor issue before merge?
rationale: The code path is plausible and well unit-tested, but ClawSweeper cannot substitute unit tests for external PR real-behavior proof, and the linked canonical issue is broader than this Android patch.

options.title: Require live proof and narrow the link
options.body: Ask for a device/emulator reconnect transcript or recording plus a PR-body update that references the broader issue without closing it.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the unit/CI evidence as enough and manually ensure the broader sequence-cursor issue stays open.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Hold the patch until the broader mobile/gateway recovery direction is settled in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and narrow the link
recommendation.body: Ask for a device/emulator reconnect transcript or recording plus a PR-body update that references the broader issue without closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent Android reconnect recovery work and authored/merged the predecessor PR that this change follows.
